_comment: Placeholder icons drawn by tools/gen_placeholder_icons.py until PixelLab art replaces them (see data/assets.json).

sfx.loot_drop_common.prompt: small item dropping onto a stone floor, soft leather and wood thud with a tiny clink, short, dry

sfx.loot_drop_rare.prompt: magic item landing on stone: a clear metallic clink with a short cold shimmer, blue sparkle feel, short
